$comment: `chunks.json` is the trigger: it is in 87 of the project's 104 packages and in all 76 that have rows in experiments.history, so there is no package with something to show and no file to click. The widget reads the store out of the opened file and derives the task from the directory name. `*.criteria.json` stays for the two explicit cases — a pointer naming a task directly, and the self-contained file `dashboard.write` produces. The excludes guard the suffix rule: 26 packages hold a plain `criteria.json` question set, which is not a pointer, and a rename must not make it one.
$name: The widget was called `criteria-dashboard` until eight superseded versions of this skill still carried a widget of that name. `dex.widgets.available()` keys every built widget by its bare name across every version on disk, last wins, and `all_skills()` walks versions in lexicographic order — so `e7e83f` beat the pinned `e6e6af` and the project was served a bundle five revisions old. Renaming is the only lever a skill has over that. If this name ever gets stale copies of its own, the cure is not another rename: delete the superseded `skills/postgres-experiments-state/<hash>/` directories, or make `resolve()` prefer the version the project has enabled.
